features.title: Public API
features.tldr: rand_engine exports DataGenerator, SparkGenerator, RandSpecs and __version__, is typed and ships the rand-engine CLI; every other module is internal.
features.summary: The supported import surface is the three names in rand_engine.__all__, the RandEngineError exception family a caller catches, the __version__ string read from installed metadata and the rand-engine console script; the wheel ships only the rand_engine package, typed, with its get-started scaffolds and llms.txt.

features.title: Templates and examples
features.tldr: Ready RandSpecs (ten cross-engine, ten pandas-only), a UTC WebServerLogs template, and Faker-pool and Arrow-schema spec builders.
features.summary: Prebuilt specs a user runs without writing a grammar — CommonRandSpecs is exported as RandSpecs and runs on both generators; AdvancedRandSpecs demonstrates correlated pandas methods; WebServerLogs assembles Apache common log lines in UTC; faker_pool and from_schema return plain RandSpec fragments from Faker or Arrow field metadata.

features.title: DataGenerator
features.tldr: The pandas generator validates a RandSpec, proves one row per column, owns its random generator, and returns DataFrames, files, file streams or record streams.
features.summary: DataGenerator(spec, seed) is the pandas composition root; construction refuses a spec that validates but cannot generate one row; size, resolved by one decider, and transformers feed get_df, stream_dict, write and writeStream, with one owned NumPy generator, a fixed column-to-modifier order, continuous key offsets and one normalized pandas record path that preserves public Python values.

features.title: Generation methods
features.tldr: Ten common methods run on pandas and Spark; pk/fk share one indexed authority; distributions, correlated methods, constants and modifiers are pandas-only.
features.summary: NPCore and PyCore provide the NumPy generator's method map, and every all-text column they generate is string[pyarrow] with pd.NA nulls; SparkCore supplies native expressions for the ten common methods. Pandas and Spark both call Keys for deterministic pk/fk values, while extra distributions, the four correlated methods, constants and modifiers remain pandas-only.

features.title: SparkGenerator
features.tldr: The Spark generator builds ordinary columns with native expressions and stateless pk/fk columns through the shared indexed key authority.
features.summary: SparkGenerator(spark, F, spec, seed) validates ordinary columns through the Spark grammar and key columns through the shared advanced key rules, starts from spark.range(size), keeps ordinary generation native and computes partition-independent keys from source row indexes.

features.title: Documentation site, llms.txt and agent skill
features.tldr: Strict-built docs, README, llms.txt and Agent guidance cover APIs, tutorials, compatibility, migration, support and security routes.
features.summary: Zensical builds an isolated site from Markdown and public docstrings, deployed to GitHub Pages from master only; README becomes the site home; every other page carries its own search description; rendered references and five tutorials cover package use; one compatibility guide covers tested boundaries, migration and recovery; llms.txt indexes rendered guides, the mirrored canonical skill and all six starter resources; and canonical contribution and security files route support and private reports.

features.title: Get-started CLI
features.tldr: The rand-engine console script lists six starters: five runnable Python examples and one opt-in AGENTS.md project context.
features.summary: rand-engine list prints six starter slugs; one Case descriptor owns each description, packaged resource, output filename and kind. get-started copies the chosen resource without overwriting: five starters produce runnable <slug>-example.py files, while agent produces AGENTS.md package-use guidance.

features.title: Writers and streaming
features.tldr: DataGenerator writes CSV, JSON lines, Parquet or an output-only SQLite table through a Spark-style builder; file streams support the three file formats.
features.summary: The batch writer distributes file output across numFiles with optional row batching, or atomically persists one generated frame to a selected SQLite table. CSV and Parquet use PyArrow, JSON uses pandas, SQLite uses the standard library, and every format accepts only documented options.

features.title: Agent eval
features.tldr: A CI gate on whether rand-engine's shipped docs let a headless agent use each feature: ten offline usage tasks, a sandbox canary, k trials per leg.
features.summary: evals/run.py runs each task under evals/tasks/ k times, each trial in a fresh temporary directory and venv, with headless claude -p isolated from host settings, skills and MCP servers, then the task's check. A usage check fails at one of three layers: artifact, provenance, documented use. evals/gate.py passes a usage task on at least k // 2 + 1 wheel passes, never fewer than the PyPI leg's, and fails on a red canary, a harness error, a missing file or a task without its task.toml token ceiling. The Agent eval gate job of eval.yml exits with that verdict and also fails on a red no-agent self-check; discovery never gates.

features.title: Performance benchmarks
features.tldr: CI enforces same-runner rand-engine regression limits and separately records bounded, validated observations against Faker and dbldatagen.
features.summary: The regression coordinator compares long-lived head workers against the latest closed release tag and enforces method, modifier and sink limits; a separate non-gating workflow installs pinned comparison dependencies and the public wheel, validates two named Python and Spark workloads, and retains raw samples, medians, plans and provenance without a winner or threshold.

features.title: PK/FK key columns
features.tldr: Stateless pk and fk column methods create related tables from definitions, seeds and row indexes on pandas and Spark, without a checkpoint store.
features.summary: A pk is a sequence or deterministic permutation of row indexes; an fk deterministically selects an eligible parent row and rebuilds its pk value. Batch parts, stream microbatches and Spark partitions use source row indexes, so keys remain consistent without shared state.

features.title: RandSpec grammar
features.tldr: A RandSpec maps output columns to a method, named kwargs and optional cols, transformers or modifiers, validated through one method catalog.
features.summary: METHOD_CATALOG is the one authority for method names, parameters, types, engines and Arrow output types; AdvancedValidator validates every DataGenerator method and the Spark key subset, while CommonValidator owns ordinary Spark intake. Structure is checked before semantics, unknown column keys, positional args, top-level constraints and a repeated output name are refused, an unknown name gets a did-you-mean line, and every issue is collected into one SpecValidationError.
